ترتشون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَشُونَ (tartašūna) /tar.ta.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# تُرْتَشَوْنَ (turtašawna) /tur.ta.ʃaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
